I’m Yubo Jia, a Master’s student at Northwest A&F University (NWAFU) from Yulin, Shaanxi, China. I expect to graduate in 2026 and plan to pursue a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Technology at Northwestern Polytechnical University (NPU).

My research centers on the [AI–hydrology intersection]{.kw}, with emphasis on [time-series modeling]{.kw}, [uncertainty quantification]{.kw}, and [physics-guided deep learning]{.kw} for hydrologic forecasting and water resources management.
:::

Background
B.Eng., Hydrology & Water Resources Engineering — Northwest A&F University, Sep 2019 – Jun 2023

M.Eng., Hydrology & Water Resources Engineering (entrance-exam exemption) — Northwest A&F University, Sep 2023 – Present
